body: The TC-003 check requires `git diff --name-status master -- doc/changes/*issue-140-* doc/changes/*issue-165-* doc/changes/*issue-203-* doc/todo/` to print nothing. The branch now adds `doc/todo/issue-200-r1-02.md` (the follow-up record that round-1 triage wrote for R1-02), so the command prints `A doc/todo/issue-200-r1-02.md` and the check fails on the correct change. testcases.md lines 59 and 64 ("every file under `doc/todo/` ... are unchanged") have the same problem. FR-RESPONSIVE-030 only needs the existing files under `doc/todo/` to stay unchanged, and a new follow-up record does not change them. Suggested fix: in both files, check `doc/todo/` with `git diff --name-status --diff-filter=DMRT master -- doc/todo/` (or exclude `doc/todo/issue-200-r*.md`), so the check covers existing todo files, including `issue-165-r1-02.md`, and still allows the pipeline's follow-up records for this issue.
